findings: Reviewed all 194 reported patch BMP capture files across ordinary and spaces installations through 69 individually inspected original-resolution hash representatives and 125 exact BMP SHA-256 duplicate reuses. Original BMP hashes/dimensions matched both native reports and viewed PNG RGB pixels matched originals.

Settled fresh and upgraded Tools/Workflow layouts are readable at the observed 960×680 and 1024×728 outer sizes. Results empty/populated states, setup and updater actions show no fixed-control overlap or blocking label clipping. Long path edits, table ellipsis, and lower scroll-panel content are expected viewport behavior.

Immediate pre-compositor frames include old source geometry: enlargement can show black bands in newly exposed right/bottom target-window areas; shrink can clip right-side and footer controls. These captures are classified as observed transients, not clean all-frame layout passes.

Some reference/transition captures include a full 1024×728 desktop rectangle while the application is 960×680. Filename size labels are not used as proof of actual dimensions; captures labelled 1280×900 do not establish that size.
Finite saved captures and native sampled assertions do not establish zero flicker, every rendered frame, high-DPI/multi-monitor/physical-trackpad behavior or representative-PC acceptance.

The separately reported baseline comparison did not reproduce a failure after DWM synchronization. This review establishes observed candidate layout only, not a proven differential fix or causal improvement.

This receipt covers patch captures only; feedback behavior/science assertions are separate. It contains capture filenames and exact hashes with bounded findings, without runner paths, token values, runtime identifiers or raw logs.
